description: Grants the core event listen/unlisten ACL to the launcher windows (main, main-*). The launcher SPA is REMOTELY served from the embedded chan-server loopback (WebviewUrl::External http://127.0.0.1:<port>/), so default.json's permissions -- which carry no `remote` scope -- do not reach it; a Tauri capability applies to remotely-loaded content only when it declares `remote.urls`. Without this the launcher's `onTauriEvent('devserver-control-attention', …)` / `onTauriEvent('devserver-control-restored', …)` (web-launcher App.svelte) is denied at runtime with `plugin:event|listen not allowed by ACL`, so the control-row attention flash never fires. `core:event:default` is not event-name-scoped, so it covers every launcher event name. Scoped to core:event only; the launcher's app-command invokes have separate narrow remote capabilities, so this capability needs no command permissions; the powerful local-only grants in default.json (updater, process, dialog) deliberately stay off remote content, mirroring the tight remote scope on workspace.json.
